AKU registers with International Quality Assurance Agencies in Higher Education

content.text: The International Network for Quality Assurance Agencies in Higher Education (INQAAHE) has approved AKU as an associate member. INQAAHE is a global association of over 200 organizations active in the theory and practice of quality assurance in higher education. The majority of its members are quality assurance regulatory agencies, including those in countries where AKU has campuses, and this membership will facilitate our relationships with those agencies.

The approval was given in recognition of the excellent work of AKU in the area of quality assurance under the leadership of Dr Tashmin Khamis. In her capacity as director of the AKU Networks of Quality, Teaching and Learning, she attended the 2015 INQAAHE Conference in Chicago in early April and engaged actively in discussions there. Dr Khamis, who is also president of the East African Higher Education Quality Assurance Network (EAQAN), was supported to attend the conference by INQAAHE and the Inter-University Council for East Africa to represent EAQAN and to present on the internal quality assurance work at AKU.
Read more about INQAAHE here or contact Dr Tashmin Khamis.
